results.title: Pointz- “Waze” For Bikes. Safety-focused mapping app for… | by Stephen Braunewell | Storied | Medium
results.snippet: Pointz uses a freemium subscription model and will monetize premium features with a subscription. Premium features include saving and sharing routes, customizing routes (ex. elevation gain, type of vehicle), and uploading/downloading GPX files.
